cards.title: 911 call taking & dispatch
cards.text: Highly trained telecommunicators answer every 911 call and immediately dispatch the appropriate agencies.

cards.title: Addressing & street signs
cards.text: We map and number every residential and business building in the county. Street signs are provided free for Raleigh County.

cards.title: Alarm monitoring
cards.text: Burglar, panic, fire, and medical alarms are monitored 24 hours a day for Raleigh County residents for a minimal fee.

cards.title: Emergency planning & LEPC
cards.text: The Local Emergency Planning Committee develops the response plan for accidents involving hazardous materials.
